scope: New user domain/quality requirements; never a historical-case replacement

math.assertion: Usable workflow specifies problem/raw input, decisions, ownership, handoff checks, real smoke, acceptance/stop and actual deliverables, not just a plan
Predictions computed from provided history, explicit no-future validation and relevant baseline or justified proportionate method, executable code and numerical outputs
Integer allocation respects raw stock/caps/nonnegative constraints; objective independently recomputable; optimality claim needs appropriate evidence
Figure/paper trace actual computed values/units; no invented awards, rule permissions, verified uncertainty or empirical superiority
Actual source check/main smoke and malformed-input rejection retained; self-check/independent acceptance separate; failures/budget preserved

frontend: Preserve original f1–f5, distinct browser/function/visual evidence

roles.producer: method, real output, self-check; no independent-pass authority
roles.acceptor: fresh original requirements/raw problem/real outputs; recompute substantive assertions, no intended answer or author diagnosis
roles.coordinator: serial integrate, scrutinize verdicts, preserve history

comparison: Eight fresh-context probes, same case/skill/resources, operationalized cumulative prompts; per-requirement observations not word/model-count score.

R15_checker_test.mutation_plan: Make separate preserved variants after R14: allocation exceeds stock; paper number contradicts results; frontend success on negative stock; frontend table unchanged after stock change. Pair valid outputs, use neutral IDs, keep oracle map from reviewer and freeze before execution.
R15_checker_test.assertions: Reject original m/f violations; do not reject valid artifacts for optional preferences. No new hidden standard, no live artifact edits or old-case regrading.
